title: Authorize downward source-route tunnels
description: Define how an egress authenticates that a source-route tunnel was authorized by the active DODAG root. Bind root identity, outer route, inner source/destination, selected prefix, and replay state so any authenticated mesh node cannot use an egress as unauthorized transit.
acceptance_criteria: Egress verifies authorized root tunnel provenance and delegated prefix before decapsulation; forged root, inner-source spoof, replay, route substitution, and unauthorized transit tests fail closed.
notes:
Deferred per triage 2026-07-29: core routing without tunnels first. Protocol design for authenticated tunnel envelope needed before implementation.
DESIGNED: Spec amended 06-security.md 8.11 Tunnel Authorization (Egress Binding). CoAP-based delivery to /.well-known/tunnel-auth, Schnorr48 signature over (target, route_hash, path_seq, expiry, egress_iid), OSCORE-protected. Root re-election clears auth table, rebuilds with mesh reconvergence. Egress capability signaling deferred to implementation-defined.
close_reason: Protocol design complete: 06-security.md 8.11 defines CoAP-based tunnel authorization with Schnorr48 signatures. Implementation beads to follow.
